legend: Flow cytometry showing patterns of heterogeneous antigen expression. A Forward versus side scatter plot showing an expanded blast population (in red and green); granulocytes are shown in yellow. B–F Although myeloperoxidase is only expressed on 6% of blasts (green), with a strong intensity (approaching the level seen in normal granulocytes), this subset expresses KIT (CD117), CD19, higher levels of CD33 and CD13, and a lower level of CD79a, and the cells are large, distinct from myeloperoxidase-negative blasts. The immunophenotypic profile demonstrates a significant heterogeneity of antigen expression. The subset that is relatively bright for myeloid markers shows a lower level of expression of lymphoid markers and consists of larger cells, while the smaller cells have relatively dim expression of myeloid and lymphoid markers.

A CD45 versus side scatter plot showing total viable cells with an expanded CD45-dim blast population (red and aqua). Mature lymphocytes are blue, and granulocytes are green. B The B-cell markers CD19 and CD79a are strongly expressed on B-lymphoid blasts (aqua) and are absent on myeloid blasts (red). C The monocytic markers CD14 and CD64 are variably expressed on myeloid blasts (red) and are absent on B-lymphoid blasts (aqua). D Myeloperoxidase is expressed on a subset of myeloid blasts (red) and is absent on B-lymphoid blasts (aqua).
